$comment: Accepted dependency advisories for the gate 11 audit (infra/security/src/audit.ts). Each entry names the advisory, the package it was accepted for, why, and the date by which it is reviewed again; an entry past its review_by date fails the audit until someone reviews it and moves the date. Remove an entry once the advisory no longer appears. The audit fails on any production advisory and on any critical advisory anywhere in the tree (malware advisories are critical).

advisories.reason: Reached only by Expo's tooling: @expo/config, @expo/prebuild-config and @expo/cli glob the repository's own app config, plugins and native targets (glob 10.5.0 and 13.0.6), never a pattern from a person, and pass no AbortSignal, which is what the advisory bypasses. The fix is glob 14, a major release Expo has not taken; Atlas's one path, @sentry/bundler-plugins' source map upload, takes 14.0.4 by override (pnpm-workspace.yaml), since it calls only glob() with options 14 keeps. Remove this entry when Expo moves to glob 14 (RRR-242). Accepted 2026-10-31; re-reviewed 2026-11-10 after the two-week rule was removed.

No pattern a person supplies reaches it: minimatch 9.0.9 and 10.2.6 come with the glob of Expo's tooling (GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4 above) and with ESLint, which match the repository's own patterns at build and lint time. minimatch below 7 is not affected, so exceljs's archiver path (minimatch 3.1.5) is clear, and eas-cli's 5.x takes 5.1.9 by override. The fix is minimatch 11, a major release; it comes with glob 14 where that is overridden. Remove this entry when Expo and ESLint move to minimatch 11 (RRR-242). Accepted 2026-10-31; re-reviewed 2026-11-10 after the two-week rule was removed.

No patched release exists (vulnerable >=4.2.0 <=4.3.1). html-to-text uses deepmerge only to combine its option objects (html-to-text.cjs: the defaults with the caller's options, and duplicate selector entries); the email HTML is parsed, never merged. Our one caller, packages/email/src/render.ts, renders plain text with fixed options ({ plainText: true }), so no attacker-controlled object reaches mergeObject(). Review when html-to-text or deepmerge ships a fix. Accepted 2026-10-28 (RRR-241, gate 11).
